thread:
marie: quick check on the playground stream controls — users confused whether 'Pause' means they can "resume" later.
dan: yep. operationally we hold the stream for a short window but we don't checkpoint partial tokens for true resume.
lee: what about renaming? 'Pause updates' vs 'Hold output' vs 'Freeze view' — need to be explicit.
anya: suggestion: primary button reads 'Pause updates' (keeps connection, UI stops appending), secondary 'Stop & release' (terminates and frees GPU). tooltip under Pause: 'Pauses UI updates for 10s; generation may continue server-side.'
marie: mobile copy needs to be shorter — maybe 'Pause updates' / 'Stop & release' fits.
ux-bot: accessibility: buttons must expose state. use `aria-pressed` or `aria-label` like "Pause updates (active)". Keyboard: propose `Esc` = soft pause, `Ctrl+Esc` = hard stop; expose in help sheet.
infra-bot: Esc is free; soft pause will send a 'stream-hold' call that keeps the session alive 10s. hard stop sends cancel and releases KV cache.
dan: also propose toast when user tries to insert a prompt while stream in-flight: short confirmation. Copy options: 1) "Inserting a prompt will stop the current response. Continue?" 2) "This will cancel the current generation. Insert anyway?" Which is clearer?
lee: 1 is clearer and softer.
anya: UX decision: Toast primary action 'Insert and stop' secondary 'Cancel'. Place toast near composer so it's visually connected.
marie: token counter — designers want both 'visible' and 'session' counts but not two big numbers. idea: show compact number (response tokens) with a chevron; expand shows breakdown: Sent | Response | Session total.
dan: backend can stream token deltas. we'll emit deltas throttled to 1s to avoid too much noise.
ux-bot: for screen readers use polite aria-live on the expanded panel and debounce announcements to 1s to avoid spamming. Also test on VoiceOver and NVDA.
lee: animation: when switching Pause -> Stop, fade out streaming waveform over 150ms and animate count to final number to avoid jumpiness.
anya: prompt library feedback: frequent users want 'Collections' and a 'Favorites' shelf at top; allow drag-to-insert and right-click 'Insert' for keyboard users. quick-insert hover should show 2-line preview and tags.
marie: keyboard support: arrow nav + Enter to insert, type-to-filter, and `/` to focus search. ensure focus moves to composer after insert.
dan: dev note: inserting while stream active — prefer prompting user. We can optionally queue the insert but that complicates server state. Let's stick with explicit confirmation for now.
ux-bot: a11y checklist added: contrast for token-pill, focus ring visible at 3px, aria-live debounce, announce toast role=alert.
marie: next steps: 1) update Figma with 'Pause updates' label + tooltip, 2) compact token counter prototype + expand state, 3) prompt library top shelf + quick-insert hover, 4) add keyboard & a11y checklist to the PR.
anya: I'll push copy variants and small motion spec.
dan: I'll implement server-side 1s token throttle and the stream-hold semantics this sprint.
lee: I'll wire animation in the playground branch and include tests for focus management.
marie: awesome. i'll follow up with screenshots and an accessibility test run. thanks team :thumbsup:
